A [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''individual''' served as an [[Imperial Agent|agent]] within the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="SWTOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Enemy Agent}}</ref> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="date">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place roughly ten to twelve [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] according to ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} lead writer, [[Daniel Erickson]]. {{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=5365704|text=Question ! :)}} Since the Treaty of Coruscant was signed in [[3653 BBY]] according to ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'', this places the events of the game at approximately [[3643 BBY]] to [[3641 BBY]]. This article uses the date of 3642 BBY as an approximate date, but the actual date could be different.</ref> the agent was willing to defect to the Republic on<ref name="SWTOR" /> the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> of [[Nal Koska]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
